title: Historical finalized Ethereum block-header event, pilot v1
description: Canonical historical header supplied by a validated source. Finality is an input assumption; this schema does not verify consensus finality, transaction ordering, logs, traces or reorgs. All times are UTC POSIX seconds. Structural validation is supplemented by replay_core validation of finite numbers and clock ordering.

event_time.description: Historical block timestamp, UTC POSIX seconds; never playback arrival.

observed_time.description: Historical observation timestamp if independently recorded, otherwise null. Never infer it from block timestamp or playback schedule.

label_available_time.description: Historical label availability if known, otherwise null. The fixed pilot detector never uses labels.

label.description: Optional audit metadata; never read by the fixed-count detector.
